statement: Every src directory carries a generated INDEX.md (one line per file: its top JSDoc summary and its importer count from the canonical import graph) produced by one generator under scripts and checked for staleness by an audit in the documentation-current shape; no src directory holds more than 120 .js files directly (control-plane 256, rebalancer 243, partition 159, query 127 today), the overflow moving into owner-named subdirectories; and docs/steering/router.md rows that point at a source file point at its directory index instead.

constraints.statement: A hand edit fails the staleness audit. The generator reads the import graph the land gate already verifies, never a second graph.
A new subdirectory is named for the owner or decision it holds, never for an ordinal or a grab-bag term, as code-style.md requires of files.
A moved file keeps its content byte-identical except import paths. A behaviour change travels in its own quest.
The 120-file cap only tightens; raising it is a refusal, not an option.
